text:
ashwin: FYI, seeing an ECC correctable error spike in ap-southeast-2 (gpool-12) over the last hour. Xid 13 and 61 counts up ~3x baseline. Telemetry: https://telemetry.redwood/streams/err?cluster=ap-southeast-2 :fire:

maria: which nodes? any pattern by model size or kernel?

ashwin: mostly p4d-24 / card slots 2/3. Error burst aligns with longer seq lengths on multitenant jobs. I'll paste quick query.

ashwin: ```sql
select node, ecc_count, xid_codes from gpu_errors where cluster='ap-southeast-2' and time > now()-1h;
```

lee: ops-bot shows two soft-drain attempts earlier but they were reverted. Any autodraind policy hit?

ops-bot: AUTO-DRYRUN: soft-drain policy would trigger on nodes [gpu-117,gpu-118] at threshold 0.2/errors/min sustained 20m. No commit performed (dryrun=true).

sam: can we correlate with OOM or retried workloads? Xid 13 historically overlaps with memory ECC + OOMs.

ashwin: good call. I'll join with scheduler logs. early correl shows 7/12 failed pods had OOMKill around same time.

anya: proposal: region-aware thresholding. ap-southeast-2 baseline noise is higher; use higher hysteresis there and prefer fallback routing to dedicated-pool-asia if available. :thinking_face:

lee: cost tradeoff: routing to dedicated pools blows out committed capacity and may force burst instances — has cost center approval?

david: ops-sre can spin up temporary burst spot GPUs in us-west as cross-region fallback? latency-sensitive jobs will break though.

maria: runbook suggestion to reduce false-positive autodrains: require (ecc_rate > thresh) AND (xid_rate > 0.5 * ecc_rate) OR (oom_count > 0) for 15m, then soft-drain, monitor 30m, then escalate.

ashwin: I like that. Also add 'no autodraind for pools tagged critical=true unless manual approval'.

lee: can we add a simulation job to replay last 48h and measure how often this rule would have autodraind? I'll run it.

sam: query to run: ```bash
gcctl export --start -48h --end now --type=gpu_errors > /tmp/errors.json
python tools/simulate_autodrain.py --rules 'ecc_xid_combined' /tmp/errors.json
```

ops-bot: Alerting: created ticket INFRA-5123 'ap-southeast-2 ecc spike - simulation + runbook' assigned to @ashwin @lee

anya: I'll draft a short customer-facing note for any tenants on gpool-12 in case we need to migrate.

ashwin: Running simulation rn, will post results in thread in ~30m. If sim suggests >5% capacity impact we trigger canary alert to ops-rotation to approve autodraind.

david: don't forget to adjust telemetry to emit 'sync_ecc_xid_oom' metric — helps automated gating.

ashwin: noted. tagging: @sre-bot can we schedule a small canary rollout of the new rule at 02:00 UTC? want to test with dryrun=false on non-critical pools.

sre-bot: scheduled canary for 02:00 UTC in ap-southeast-2 on pools gpool-13,gpool-14 (dryrun=no, notify=on) — will report.
